entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return an order.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes. It's VF0-8675309.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Carbon Pro road cycling shoes, delivered on October 16th. Is that correct?
That's it.
Okay. And to make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
They give me blisters. I've tried everything with the cleats, but they're just not right.
I'm very sorry to hear that; getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Fine.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our policy, and since the item was delivered 62 days ago, it's still well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process a full refund for you.
Finally. So you're approving the refund?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you now, which I'll send to the email on file. Just package the cycling shoes back in their box and drop them off with the carrier. Once we receive them, we'll issue the refund.
Whatever. Just send the label.

It's on its way. Also, I see you're a VIP member with us, and I want to apologize again for the trouble with these shoes. To thank you for your loyalty to VeloFit, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next order.
Right. Is that it?
Yes, that's everything on my end. The return is approved and the label is sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find a better-fitting pair of shoes for you in the future. Have a good day.
